title: Search dropdown on the Contacts and Accounts lists
text: When you type in the search box of the Contacts list or the Accounts list, a dropdown now appears under it while you type, with up to eight matches. For a person it shows their email and companies; for a company it shows its status, state and people. Click a match, or use the arrow keys and Enter, to open it straight away.
points: It starts after two letters and uses the same search as the search at the top of the app, so both always agree on who matches.
Pressing Enter with nothing highlighted still filters the whole list by what you typed, exactly as before. The last line of the dropdown reminds you.
Escape, a click elsewhere or Tab closes it. If nothing matches, it says so.
A person is found by name, email, phone or one of their companies' names; a company by its name or one of its people.
